summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Party Ledger T-format (Jama | Kharch) for BYAJ-group ledgers. Every requested check passed: the default layout is picked by group, LABBU's T-format numbers are correct, the toggle choice is remembered per kind in localStorage across reloads and across BYAJ ledgers, print shows PartyTStatement in T layout and PartyStatement in Ledger layout, the edit link opens the Rokad edit form, delete asks for confirmation and Cancel keeps the entry, Excel export works, Print/PDF throw no errors, Cash/Bank ledgers show no toggle, and the Byaj Report and Rokad pages still work. No page errors.

issues: Memo row Vivran is cut off ('INTEREST RECEIVED · M...') in the 50/50 side tables at 1920px. The full text is only in the title tooltip. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: PartyLedger.jsx: layoutPick is component state and is not reset when :id changes. If the user moves from a BYAJ party to a normal party without the component remounting (e.g. an in-app Link between two /parties/:id routes), the old pick is carried over. Suggest resetting layoutPick in a useEffect on [id], or deriving it only from localStorage.

PartyTFormat memo rows have no edit/delete actions because editHref returns null for kind 'memo'. This is acceptable, but a pencil linking to /rokad?edit=<refId> would help users fix a wrong byaj memo directly from the ledger.
On the INTEREST RECEIVED (income) ledger the header reads 'WE OWE PARTY' for the ₹4,500 Dr balance. This wording comes from the generic party logic and is misleading for an income head. Cosmetic.
